title: Something old
notes: Starfleet's answer for this planet is a Q, and it is wrong. Nobody says so:
she mentions it early, less as the fragments come in, and not at all once
they are all on tape. The theory dies of accumulation.

lines.text: Shepard. Your probe flagged something. Not dilithium.
Shepard. The probe's signal. Have you looked yet?
A holo emitter. A small one, very old. Three hundred
years, give or take, in a world that shouldn't have
a holo emitter at all. Somebody left a recording.

options.text: Why would anyone do that here?

lines.text: There's a file on this planet. You'll have heard
of the Q. Starfleet's view is that one made this place.
A copy of Earth, dropped here, for a joke or a test.
It's the only category they have. It's not a bad one.
I believe I'd like to hear the recording.
Bring it to me, off the PADD. Hail me with it on you.
And don't die with it. It's the only one we know of.
